findings.evidence: `Torus/CharacterLattice/Basic.lean:58 characterLattice_module_free_of_torus` and `:65 characterLattice_module_finite_of_torus`, plus `Torus/Cocharacter.lean:64 cocharacterLattice_module_free` / `:74 cocharacterLattice_module_finite`, all speak in `Module.Free`/`Module.Finite`; grep finds no lemma relating `galoisLatticeProperty` to either class.
findings.fix: Add the accessors and constructor next to the definition: `theorem galoisLatticeProperty.module_free`, `.module_finite` (from the existential, via `AddEquiv.toIntLinearEquiv` as in `Torus/CharacterLattice/Basic.lean:62,69`), and `theorem galoisLatticeProperty.mk_of_free_finite` in the reverse direction; or restate the first conjunct as `Module.Finite ℤ M ∧ Module.Free ℤ M` and keep the existential as a derived lemma.
findings.issue: `galoisLatticeProperty` encodes finite freeness as `∃ n, Nonempty (M ≃+ (Fin n →₀ ℤ))` and offers only `galoisLatticeProperty_iff := Iff.rfl`. A consumer holding a `GaloisLatticeCat k` object cannot obtain `Module.Free ℤ M` / `Module.Finite ℤ M`, and cannot build an object from those instances, without re-deriving `Module.Free.of_equiv` / `Module.Finite.equiv` by hand — even though the repo's own torus results are already stated in the class form. The `≃+` (rather than `≃ₗ[ℤ]`) phrasing is what forces the `let _ : Module ℤ X := X.hV2` instance juggling in the `IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms` proof at lines 66-67.

findings.evidence: Grep for `characterRepresentationFunctor` across `TauCeti/` returns hits only in this file (lines 109, 114, 115, 116, 135, 147, 148); the Main declarations block at lines 25-28 lists only `galoisLatticeProperty`, `GaloisLatticeCat`, and `characterLatticeFunctor`.
findings.fix: Mark it `private`, and phrase `characterLatticeFunctor_obj` / the new `characterLatticeFunctor_map` directly in terms of `geometricCharacterRepresentation` and `geometricCharacterRepresentationMap`.
findings.issue: `characterRepresentationFunctor` is public but is a staging artifact — its own docstring says it is the functor "before recording finite freeness and open stabilizers in its codomain". It is absent from the module's Main declarations, its membership proof at line 114 is `private`, and its only uses are lines 135 and 147 of this file. It duplicates `characterLatticeFunctor ⋙ (galoisLatticeProperty k).ι` as a second, weaker public name for the same functor.

summary: Both new functors expose only an `_obj` lemma and no `_map` lemma, so the morphism part — precisely what the stated next step (full faithfulness of the descent functor) needs — is only reachable by unfolding. `galoisLatticeProperty` also ships no bridge to the `Module.Finite`/`Module.Free` form the repo's own torus lemmas produce.
